blocks.text: Room routing configuration (spec.routing). Names a script that exports pickRoom(ctx): evaluated once per joining player, before the room connection is made. Absent, a player joins the room their invite, portal or link names, else the default room. The ctx shape, the routing patterns and the…

RoutingDef = { script?: ScriptRef // Script ref under scripts/ exporting `async function pickRoom(ctx)` (e.g. "scripts/routing.js"). Returns a room name, or `{ room, persistence }`: the name and the class the room wears; null/throw falls back to the default room. maxPlayers?: number // Per-room cap on BODIES (a positive integer, any size): the room's door refuses the body past it (`room full`) and the pick runs again with that room in `ctx.rejectedRooms`; the player reads the refusal only when the rule names no other room. Who counts: every player body: a human, an inhabitant agent, an agent's own account; Savi's helper body and a wisp's never take a slot, so size the cap for the players alone. Unset = no cap: every player in it. persistence?: PlacePersistence // The class every room the rule names wears unless its pick's answer names one: `persistent` (the default: a room keeps what happens in it), `session` (its things live one room-life: from the first arrival until the room has stood empty a while), `ephemeral` (they die with its last player). A player's own durables persist under every class. alwaysOn?: boolean // `true` asks Spawn to visit the world while nobody is in it: on a fixed cadence, for a bounded time after the last player left, Spawn's own machine opens the room once, runs the crons and the `sim.js` ticks owed since the last visit, and leaves. Nothing runs between visits; the word never keeps a server up. The cadence, the horizon and the shape the world's code takes live in the rooms-and-matchmaking skill. Unset = off. }
